items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father was Stanley Joseph Aebersold, and my mom was Wilma E. (Evelyn) Dierking.

ctx.x: Can we talk about your parents. You were born here, and of course, your parents have quite a legacy also. If we can get your father’s, your mother’s name, and any other relatives, and talk about their life here in New Albany.

Ok. My father was Stanley Joseph Aebersold, and my mom was Wilma E. (Evelyn) Dierking. And they married in the early ’30s, I think it was. And my grandfather and grandmother were dead before I was born, so I didn’t get to see them. I didn’t have any grandparents at all, as a matter of fact. My father’s father, I’m pretty sure he came from Switzerland, and settled down in Brandenburg, Kentucky. Then he moved up to New Albany, here, Indiana, which is about 50 miles from Brandenburg, and I think he started a nursery…
So that’s where the banjo comes from.
